## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
- Kafka repartition offset migration must run “in between” other work.
- Do not retry increasing the Celery `visibility_timeout` for duplicate jobs; `cache-eu-1` must not receive staging writes.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix incorrect Quebec QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. OpenTelemetry tracing is superseded; Kafka migration remains in between.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Kafka `kafka-01:9092`, topic `orders.v1`, group `orders-v1`, 6 partitions, replication factor 3. Redis `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` superseded. Billing uses `args.currency`; `args.filters["currency"]` superseded. Rebuild chunks 100.

## Ruled-out approaches
Do not increase Celery visibility timeout. Avoid per-invoice embedding, tenant-less rebuild scans, per-document clients, nested currency namespaces, and bespoke billing groups.

## Plan and progress
Done: consumer group stopped; offsets queried; tenant scoping/shared embedder/bulk upsert/index migration implemented; 247 passed, 4 skipped; benchmarks and CSV UTF-8 tests pass. Quebec fix pending; no next command supplied. Kafka offset migration pending.
